snapshot.body.text:
You're losing money if you're still running traditional direct response ads.

A VSL or webinar funnel on its own has one killer problem: trust. 

Only a tiny slice of people are confident enough to see one ad, watch a VSL, and book a call right there. 

Everyone else isn't ready yet, so they vanish. 

You only ever catch the people who were ready today.

The profile funnel V2 fixes that. You still run your normal funnel with the pre-frame process in place, but now your leads can also go to your Instagram and YouTube and consume way more content. 

Once they follow you, they're getting nurtured forever, not lost.

So instead of only converting the ready-to-buy few, you keep everyone warm until they're ready.

That's how I hit a 12x ROAS last month, $152k USD, around $210k AUD, from the same ad spend.
